comment: DRAFT (RUNBOOK A.6, 24 Oct 2026): C3 label sweep on deepthought, the primary sweep host (PLAN §10 R1-SWEEP-HOST, 24 Oct; no mixing hosts within one labelled table). ENGINEERING_ONLY config; the sweep output is PILOT label data. AI-assisted (Claude), not launch-ready: every value "TODO_VERIFY_ON_DEEPTHOUGHT" must be read on deepthought (checklist in docs/r1/overnight/BATCH_A_24OCT_HANDOFF.md); the runner refuses to launch while any is left, and `--check-config --allow-placeholders` validates the rest. SAME AS THE ADA CONFIG (r1/scripts/configs/c3_sweep_ada.json): the eight D21 nodes, 18 instances, W = 20, both memory modes, liveness 2 x W = 10 memory on, transport retry 3, gates, audit K = 10 (7001..7010, 5 + 5); the pinned manager qwen2.5-coder:7b and its digest are runner constants (MODEL, DIGEST), so both configs use the same pin. ONE MANAGER PER TITAN: the runner drives ONE dedicated Ollama instance on ONE card per batch, so this file configures one manager on one TITAN (gpu_uuid). Using all four TITANs needs either four batches (one per card, disjoint node subsets, distinct ports and tmux sessions; the launcher's session name r1_c3_sweep is fixed today) or a multi-instance runner: an open design question for the author/coordinator, not decided here. CPU WORKERS: workers = parallel root campaigns sharing this batch's one manager (OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1); the CPU worker runs and later audits use the many cores. PROPOSED (not decided): watchdog enabled (RUNBOOK A.8); resume per campaign root on (RUNBOOK A.5, runner default). KNOWN RISK (STATUS 12 Oct): deepthought's GTX TITAN X (compute capability 5.2) with driver 525.147.05 is below the driver Ollama documents for that capability; GPU offload there was never demonstrated. The runner STOPs unless size_vram = size after loading.
